verdict.rationale: Railway's docs directly state it offers "One-click deployable applications and starters for common use cases," which matches the story almost word for word. The MCP server docs add that AI assistants can "deploy templates," confirming templates are a first-class platform object. The evidence is still a one-line docs claim with no description of the catalog or the deploy flow. Missing for 10: details on template catalog breadth and which use cases are covered, documentation of the one-click deploy flow and customization of template variables, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy one-click templates and starters for common use cases

citations.quote: One-click deployable applications and starters for common use cases.
It lets AI assistants create projects, deploy templates, manage environments, pull variables, and redeploy services.
